articles.title: Route 66: The 100-Year-Old Road That Still Makes People Sing
articles.summary: Route 66, America's famous 'Mother Road,' turns 100 on November 11, 2026. It once ran 2,400 miles from Chicago to Los Angeles, and now eight states are throwing festivals and car shows to celebrate.

articles.title: Could AI Wake Up? Readers Share Their Wildest Fears and Hopes
articles.summary: Live Science asked readers if AI could become conscious. Over 290 people voted, and 43% said yes — if we don't have safety guardrails. One reader joked, 'Maybe that is how Transformers started?'

articles.title: Def Leppard's Wild Ride: From Sheffield to Rock Legends in New Documentary
articles.summary: A new documentary called 'Long Live Def Leppard' hits theaters in early 2027. It tells how five working-class guys from Sheffield, England, sold 110 million albums and survived two heartbreaking tragedies.
